access_method: Official Firebase public API v0; fixed HTTPS host only
allowed_purpose: Bounded public discussion research; no profile enrichment, training, article crawling or messaging
operator_rate_limit: At most four requests/second, sequential, 60 items/run
enforcement: Stop on 401/403/429, bounded 5xx retries, never follow redirects or source URLs
retention_policy: Store normalized/redacted permitted excerpt only; expiry hides content; daily purge deletes dependents; explicit removal tombstones source identifiers/hash
attribution: Original Hacker News item URL, author handle, original timestamp
policy_note: Official API documentation describes public access; no blanket claim of third-party content ownership. Operator must honor removal and applicable source requirements. Database source_policies is the runtime kill switch.
